items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charles, Jackie, Bobby, Larry and yourself. You recorded two tracks...

ctx.x: Bobby Hutcherson was on that session?

Yeah, so the very first session, "Inglewood," probably at Van Gelder Studios, July 1965, Charles, Jackie, Bobby, Larry and yourself. You recorded two tracks "Climax" and "On The Nile" and then the “Jackknife” session. That was in September 1965. That one included “Soft Blue,” another take of "Climax," and then "Jackknife" and "Blue Fable." The first session was not issued. The second session, the one you just mentioned, was the first.
